# SEO, AEO, GEO, And Locale Surfaces

The landing site ships **16 locale catalogues** with **490 leaf message keys** in the English baseline. Route metadata, sitemap entries, discovery files, and AI-readable summaries are one release contract.

## Discovery Assets

| Asset | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [public/robots.txt](../../public/robots.txt) | Search and AI crawler policy. |
| [public/llms.txt](../../public/llms.txt) | Concise answer-engine index. |
| [public/llms-full.txt](../../public/llms-full.txt) | Expanded citation-ready product index. |
| [public/image-sitemap.xml](../../public/image-sitemap.xml) | Discoverable product imagery. |
| [public/discovery-manifest.json](../../public/discovery-manifest.json) | Machine-readable discovery inventory. |
| [public/.well-known/security.txt](../../public/.well-known/security.txt) | Responsible disclosure contact policy. |
| [public/bimi/flyto2.svg](../../public/bimi/flyto2.svg) | BIMI-compatible brand mark. |
